title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Responsibilities Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options. Find the right suppliers. You run market scans, requests for information and requests for quote. Then you shortlist the suppliers worth a closer look. Judge capability together. You work with R&D, Production, Finance and Compliance to build one clear view of what each supplier can do. Negotiate the deal. You agree pricing, volume tiers, tooling and payment terms. You also set up the NDAs, supply agreements and long-term agreements that back them. Set suppliers up properly. You onboard new suppliers and keep vendor data, price breaks and lead times current in our ERP system. Lead supplier qualification. You coordinate our tiered qualification process, including quality agreements and first-article inspections. Audit on site and remotely. You check suppliers for quality management, traceability and compliance. You also screen them against trade compliance requirements. Keep builds moving. You place and expedite orders for prototype, validation, pilot and pre-series builds. You track supplier performance on delivery, price and quality. Bring costs down. You work with suppliers on cost reduction, using should-cost and landed-cost models. Grow our supplier base. You qualify suppliers for additional production sites and regions, reusing existing qualification records. Make it repeatable. You document sourcing processes, templates and playbooks, so the purchasing team can take over mature suppliers. Requirements You have 6+ years in sourcing, purchasing or new product introduction for hardware products, across a variety of product types, complexities and technologies. You can read technical drawings and specifications, and you work closely with engineers. You’re willing to travel regularly, including international trips of several days. You’ve audited suppliers hands-on or worked within a quality management system such as ISO 9001. You have working knowledge of trade compliance rules. You’ve used an ERP system for purchasing and vendor data. You have a qualification in engineering, supply chain, business or a related field. You communicate excellently in English and build good working relationships with colleagues and suppliers. Plus Experience in aerospace, drones or other safety-critical products Experience sourcing custom electromechanical parts such as plastic parts, motors, batteries and avionics Experience qualifying suppliers for production in more than one region Experience with supplier scorecards and performance reporting If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. description: Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com ! We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife We are looking for a Senior Technical Accountant to join our growing Finance function, reporting to the Head of Technical Accounting. You’ll provide technical accounting support for ongoing business activities, new products and other initiatives, and play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s work, from accounting policy assessments to horizon scanning, audit engagement and the annual report. Strong stakeholder management is key to this role. The demands on the Finance team are high as Zopa grows at pace, so you’ll need to build effective and influential relationships within Finance and the wider business. Our team are self-starting problem solvers who are agile and thrive on bringing past experiences and networks to a diverse range of challenges. You’ll be part of an impressive Zopa team, who are super collaborative and happy to roll their sleeves up and get involved in whatever needs doing to achieve their goals. A day in the life Carry out technical accounting assessments for new transactions, products, significant contracts and other business initiatives, and draft clear accounting papers and memos. Play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s ownership of the annual report and accounts, drafting parts of the report and coordinating other sections written by teams across Finance and the wider business, and helping to bring them together into the final report. Manage stakeholders effectively and work well with other Zopa teams, including Product, Legal, Treasury and Risk, building strong, influential relationships and giving clear, practical technical accounting advice. Support the development, implementation and upkeep of accounting policies and the accounting manual and give practical guidance on how policies should be applied across the business. Help put new accounting treatments into practice: make sure finance systems and processes are set up to support new activities, embed them into business-as-usual (BAU) processes and hand them over to the BAU teams. Support the technical accounting for balance sheet activity, including SPPI testing and hedge accounting assessments and documentation under IAS 39 and IFRS 9. Support the timely and accurate delivery of month-end reporting where needed. Work directly with the external auditors on accounting policy and technical accounting matters, answering queries and providing evidence and papers. Carry out horizon scanning of new and proposed legislation, regulation and accounting standards that affect financial and corporate reporting, prepare impact assessments, and highlight high-impact or high-risk changes. Help shape and deliver our work to automate the production of the annual report, an area where this role will be fundamental. Look for ways to use AI and automation to improve technical accounting, policy and reporting processes, and put them into practice. Keep up to date with developments in financial and corporate reporting . About you: Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with relevant post-qualification experience. Experience of working in the financial services sector (ideally banking or consumer finance), or trained at a top six accountancy firm with financial services experience in a technical accounting role. Solid working knowledge of IFRS and how it applies to financial services products and transactions. Clear written communication, with experience of drafting technical accounting papers or memos and explaining complex accounting to non-accountants. A questioning mindset, and the ability to drive change to systems and processes to improve efficiency. A team player and problem solver. You’ll show great initiative to listen, analyse, research, investigate and provide solutions to problems relating to financial accounting and reporting. Comfortable managing several pieces of work at once in a fast-moving environment, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels. Curious about AI and how you can use it in your everyday work. Motivated, energetic and passionate about excellence and innovation. Bonus points for Technical knowledge of IFRS 9 (expected credit losses, EIR), hedge accounting (IFRS 9 and IAS 39), IFRS 2 (share-based payments), and IAS 38 (intangible assets). Experience of operational accounting. #LI-LK1 At Zopa we value flexible ways of working. We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week. You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one. *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice Diversity Statement Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. Our approach to AI in interviews At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. Behavioural and competency-based interviews : please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. The Role For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day. That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others. T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included. A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code. Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain). Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

title: Principal Implementation Engineer, Customer Support
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com. 

Bitwarden truly cares and wants all Bitwarden users to have the best experience while accessing their sensitive information. The Customer Success team helps customers and all users meaningfully engage with Bitwarden products while proactively planning for user growth, service availability, and to ultimately achieve their desired outcome. Team members have excellent product knowledge, superb technical skills, stellar grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complicated things simply.

Bitwarden seeks a server and cloud enthusiast, with experience in both communicating about and deploying these technologies. You will become a Bitwarden product expert and partner with the Customer Engagement Managers to help customers with their initial production deployments post-sales, as well as implement new features as they are released and increase their adoption of the Bitwarden platform.

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the UK.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Functioning as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Bitwarden and its suite of services
  • Leading technical planning and execution of new deployments, both to establish and adopt best-practices with a focus on large Enterprise engagements
  • Advising customers on industry best practices for the full stack of Bitwarden  
  • Working with customers to solve issues and/or look ahead to identify solutions to situations they may face in the future
  • Providing superb guidance and assistance for each customer’s implementation of Bitwarden and general security
  • Serve as a dedicated customer point of contact for named customers through alignment to Customer Engagement Manager resources through the Bitwarden ticketing and email systems
  • Participate in customer quarterly business reviews by assisting in environment audits, best-practices reviews, and positioning new product features relevant to further expansion opportunities and/or increased adoption
  • Collaborating with Engineering and Product associates to triage bug reports and feature requests based on customer need and scale with a focus on large Enterprise deployments
  • Assist training and culture sharing in the Implementation Engineering Team
  • Guide knowledge sharing among Implementation Engineers within the team and in collaboration with Technical Writing to share best-practices, troubleshooting information, and recommended configurations
  • Lead and/or assist in internal team projects including customer environment replication for bug investigations, integrations with new third-party tools, and development of automations both for customer use-cases as well as internal team processes
  • Occasionally represent Bitwarden at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • Excellent English and grammar
  • Excellent problem-solving skills (you might not know all the answers but you know how to find and communicate the solutions)
  • A passion for supporting your team members, growing together (technical ability and emotional intelligence), and sharing your knowledge with all

  • Experience from a previous technical position (e.g. Systems Engineer, Implementation Engineer, DevOps Engineer, IT Infrastructure Engineer, etc). Equivalent education or demonstrable skills may be accepted
  • Ability and desire to work remotely

Familiarity with several of the following areas/technologies is preferred:

  • Bitwarden
  • Linux, Windows, and macOS

  • GitHub
  • NGINX
  • SQL
  • TCP/IP
  • DNS
  • HTTP
  • SMTP
  • SAML and OpenID Connect
  • TLS/SSL and PKI

  • Screening call with our Recruiting Team
  • Interview with Implementation Engineering Manager
  • Interviews with Implementation Engineering team members
  • Interview with Chief Customer Officer and Customer Success Manager

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate ! You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving. You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate. You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat. What Can You Expect? Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack. Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting. Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation. Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest. Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day. Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate. Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly. Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible. About You You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs. You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before. You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making. You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts. You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next. At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Meta & Google (H/F)
description: À propos de Scento Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté. Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. Sur Scento.com, les ventes mensuelles de décants de septembre 2026 représentaient 3,2 fois celles de janvier 2026. Selon Scento, plus de 3 millions de décants de parfum sont vendus chaque année, soit environ un toutes les 10 secondes. En novembre 2025, Scento a annoncé un investissement de 25 millions d'euros sur trois ans dans la découverte du parfum en Europe. Le poste L'acquisition payante est l'un des principaux moteurs de croissance de Scento. Nous vendons des décants de parfum de créateurs et de niche à des clients répartis sur 27 marchés européens, avec des budgets mensuels importants à placer sur Meta, Google et de nouveaux canaux. En tant que Senior Performance Marketing Manager, vous êtes responsable de la performance de ces comptes. Le succès, c'est un CAC maîtrisé, un délai de retour sur investissement qui respecte nos objectifs, et une capacité à identifier vite ce qu'il faut arrêter et ce qu'il faut amplifier. Vos missions Vous pilotez et faites monter en puissance les comptes Meta et Google de Scento (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Advantage+) sur les marchés européens. Vous gérez budgets, enchères, structure de compte et tests, au regard d'objectifs de CAC et de délai de retour. Vous briefez et testez les créations avec l'équipe marque, lisez la donnée créative et décidez vite d'arrêter ou d'amplifier. Vous veillez à la santé du tracking avec l'analytics et la data (Conversions API, conversions avancées, GA4). Vous ouvrez de nouveaux marchés et de nouveaux canaux, comme TikTok et Microsoft Ads, quand les chiffres le justifient. Votre profil Plus de 6 ans d'acquisition payante en e-commerce, avec de gros budgets mensuels. Une expertise approfondie de Meta Ads et de Google Ads, et de solides compétences en tableurs et en analytics. Une expérience sur plusieurs pays européens. Un anglais courant ; le français ou l'allemand est un plus. Ce que nous proposons Une rémunération située dans le haut du marché, complétée par une prime annuelle sur performance. Du télétravail possible partout dans l'UE, avec des bureaux à Paris (place Vendôme) et à Berlin. Une généreuse allocation mensuelle de parfums pour explorer l'ensemble du catalogue. Un budget de formation personnel de 2 500 € par an (cours, conférences, livres). Le matériel de votre choix et un budget d'aménagement de votre espace de travail. Une vraie autonomie et des décisions rapides, dans une entreprise qui se développe vite à travers l'Europe. Rémunération et candidature Rémunération : de 95 000 € à 125 000 € brut par an, en CDI à temps plein, plus une prime annuelle sur performance. Lieu : Paris ou Berlin, ou en télétravail depuis toute l'Union européenne. Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

title: Responsable QHSE H/F
description: Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Employant plus de 250 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de 130 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Mettre en place et superviser la politique Qualité : Mettre en place des systèmes de qualité conformes aux normes ISO Mettre à jour les procédures en place, créer des procédures inexistantes par rapport à nos cibles et attentes clients ; Accompagner et sensibiliser les manageurs sur les normes ISO et ses enjeux ; Superviser les audits internes et externes, ainsi que la gestion et l’analyse des incidents et non-conformités. Suivre la conformité aux normes d’Hygiène et de Sécurité : Mettre en place les procédures visant à la sécurité des biens et des personnes, et veiller à leur respect ; Mettre en place et suivre les formations internes de sécurité et les plans de prévention des risques pour le personnel ; Rédiger et tenir à jour le Document Unique d’Évaluation des Risques Professionnels ; En collaboration avec le service RH, analyser les accidents du travail et presque-accidents, et piloter les actions correctives associées. Environnement et RSE : Définir et déployer la stratégie RSE du Groupe en lien avec la Direction Générale ; Réaliser des enquêtes et rapports ESG à destination des parties prenantes ; Participer aux démarches de certification et labellisation RSE (EcoVadis…). Élaborer les chartes, procédures et supports de communication interne ; Piloter la gestion des déchets et le respect des obligations environnementales ; Sensibiliser les collaborateurs aux enjeux environnementaux et sociétaux ; Préparer le reporting à la Direction et proposer des actions d’amélioration continue ; Contribuer aux projets sociaux : QVT, inclusion, égalité ; Assurer une veille réglementaire RSE/ESG. Vos compétences Diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 en Qualité, Sécurité, Environnement ou d’une école d’ingénieur avec une spécialisation QHSE / RSE, vous possédez au moins 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire, idéalement acquise dans un environnement multi-sites (logistique, distribution ou retail). Vous maîtrisez la réglementation en matière de sécurité et d’environnement, et êtes familier(ère) des enjeux et référentiels RSE / ESG. Vos excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse sont un réel atout ; un anglais professionnel serait apprécié. Pédagogue et doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous savez fédérer et sensibiliser à tous les niveaux de l’entreprise. Enfin, votre rigueur, votre sens de l’organisation, votre autonomie et votre force de proposition seront les clés de votre réussite dans ce poste. Rémunération selon profil. title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer - AI Resilience & Security Enhancements (Fixed-term contract)
description:
THE PROJECT 📝 

We're looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to join Form3 on a 12 month fixed term contract basis to deliver a strategic programme of security enhancements across our cloud-native payments platform. 

Focusing on improving cloud security, operational resilience and governance across our engineering ecosystem, you will work closely with our Platform Engineering and Security teams to design and implement practical security improvements that enhance how we build, deploy and operate critical payment infrastructure. 

You'll play a key role in strengthening areas such as cloud platform security, software supply chain security, identity and access management, AI governance, cryptographic controls and automated security assurance, ensuring solutions are scalable, production-ready and aligned with regulatory expectations. 

Key responsibilities 

  • Assess the current cloud security posture across Form3 environments, identifying risks, control gaps and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls that improve the resilience and security of our cloud-native platform. 
  • Enhance perimeter security controls across cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strengthen CI/CD pipeline security through secure build processes, automated security testing, deployment governance and artefact integrity. 
  • Improve production access security, including RBAC, least-privilege implementation, deployment tooling and operational processes. 
  • Enhance software supply chain security through dependency management, container image scanning, provenance, signing and vulnerability remediation. 
  • Contribute to the secure adoption and governance of AI-enabled engineering capabilities, including controls for data protection, auditability and operational resilience. 
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on cloud security architecture and secure engineering practices. 
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, including solution designs, implementation plans, operational procedures and security evidence. 
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, platform and security teams to deliver maintainable, production-ready security improvements. 
  • Ensure all deliverables align with operational resilience requirements, regulatory obligations and internal security standards. 
  • Deliver changes using structured, low-risk change management practices while maintaining service availability. 

 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍 

Essential 

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing cloud security solutions within large-scale cloud-native environments. 
  • Strong hands-on experience securing public cloud platforms (AWS preferred). 
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture, identity and access management, workload protection and infrastructure security. 
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. 
  • Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including dependency management, artefact signing, provenance and vulnerability management. 
  • Experience implementing least-privilege access models and RBAC. 
  • Knowledge of security monitoring, risk assessment and security governance. 
  • Experience working within highly regulated or business-critical production environments. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams. 
  • Strong technical documentation and design skills. 

 

Desirable 

  • Experience implementing security controls for AI or machine learning platforms. 
  • Knowledge of cryptographic controls and key management. 
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and policy-as-code tooling. 
  • Familiarity with payment platforms or financial services environments. 
  • Understanding of operational resilience frameworks and regulatory requirements affecting critical financial infrastructure. 
  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP or similar). 

 

TECH STACK ⚙️ 

  • AWS – Cloud infrastructure and security controls. 
  • Kubernetes – Container orchestration and workload security. 
  • Terraform – Infrastructure as Code and security automation. 
  • CI/CD tooling – Secure software delivery, build security and deployment governance. 
  • Container security tooling – Image scanning, vulnerability management and runtime protection. 
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) – Least privilege, RBAC and privileged access controls. 
  • Software Supply Chain Security – Dependency scanning, artefact signing, provenance and integrity controls. 
  • Security monitoring & observability platforms – Detection, auditability and operational visibility. 
  • AI governance and security controls – Supporting secure adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities. 

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️ 

Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team 

Stage 2: Cloud Security & Engineering Best Practices interview 

Stage 3 (optional): Team interview

We always aim to stick to the above process, however there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we’re hiring the right fit for the role. 

 

HIRING LOCATIONS📍 

Here are the locations that we are looking to hire from for this role. Please note, we are not looking to engage with candidates outside of these locations. 

  • UK

All new team members start their first day in our office to collect the equipment needed to work remotely. 

 

ABOUT FORM3 💭 

Revolutionising the world of payments with our cloud-native, multi-cloud platform. For more information about Form3, check out the following pages: 

What we do | Life at Form3 | Payments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast

title: Strategy Director
description:
Department: One Unilever 

Location: London 

Contact type: 12 months FTC 

Full Time/Part time: Full Time 

Reporting into: Chief Strategy Officer, OUL. 

 

About Ogilvy:  

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. Ogilvy UK specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Molson Coors (owner of Madrí beer), Valeo Foods UK (owner of Kettle Chips and Rowse Honey), Argos, Mondelēz International, Unilever, TK Maxx and Pernod Ricard. 

In 2023, Ogilvy UK celebrated their 75th anniversary and was the most awarded agency in Europe. Ogilvy is home to the largest influencer marketing practice globally, and hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – now in its 12th year. 

 

The Role: 

As a Global Strategy Director focused on the dynamic and social-forward beauty and wellness sector at Ogilvy, you will play a pivotal role in leading the development of strategic plans tailored to meet the client's distinct objectives and needs. You'll stay at the forefront of the latest beauty and wellbeing trends, cultural insights, and best practices in the realm of creative strategy development while advocating for diversity of thought and championing inclusive approaches. Collaborating closely with clients, you'll gain a deep understanding of their global business, target audiences, and brand values, translating this knowledge into compelling culturally driven campaigns that resonate with their customers and drive tangible outcomes. 

You'll actively contribute to social and cultural insight mining to shape the agency's creative output. Your recommendations and inventive solutions will pave the way for clients to amplify trends and topics effectively. 

 

Key Responsibilities/The Do’s: 

· Lead the development of bespoke strategic plans that align with clients' unique goals, incorporating the latest trends and best practices. 

· Work in a social-first culture-forward way to build big campaign ideas. 

· Collaborate closely with clients to grasp their business, target audience, and brand ethos, and formulate campaigns that resonate and yield results. 

· Conduct in-depth research and analysis, using social tools, to pinpoint emerging trends, influencers, and topics that can enhance compelling content and campaigns. 

· Partner with internal teams—creative, account, and media—to ensure campaign integration aligns with overall brand strategy. 

· Emerge as a thought leader both within the agency and the industry at large, sharing insights, trends, and best practices with teams and clients. 

· Stay updated on the latest trends, technologies, and tools in influence and social marketing, applying this knowledge to enhance campaign performance. 

· Develop influential and innovative social strategies for high-profile clients, deeply rooted in culture and deserving of attention. 

· Collaborate with planners, creatives, and creators to collaboratively address challenges and deliver exceptional work. 

· Recognise opportunities for clients to harness and amplify trends and topics.

title: Principal Engineer, Platform
description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

 

 

ROLE SUMMARY 

 Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Engineer, Platform to own the platform Firmus engineers build and release on, in public cloud and in our own data centres. Self-service and security come first: through one golden path, an engineer should be able to create a service, get an environment, and ship to production securely with minimal support. Everything you design must work across sites and scale to hundreds of thousands of GPUs in gigawatt-scale AI factories. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Architecture and Decisions 

  • Own the architecture of the engineering platform and its multi-site management plane, in public cloud and on premises. Set a target architecture two to three years ahead and plan the steps from today's system to it. 
  • Design the platform around a repeatable scaling unit. Capacity grows in identical units, a failure stays inside one unit or site, and each site meets a defined standard before it carries the platform. 
  • Decide how internal Kubernetes and hypervisor clusters are built, networked, upgraded, and recovered. Keep Kubernetes conformant and close to upstream releases, with upgrades that need no downtime. New sites come up from code and the site deployment kit, and recovery is tested regularly. 
  • Decide how services are packaged, released, and promoted with progressive rollout, and how a failed release is rolled back and contained across sites. 
  • Lead design reviews for significant changes across the teams, sign off architecture decision records, and settle technical disputes escalated by engineers. Decide at pace with incomplete information, write down the assumptions, and revisit a decision when the evidence changes. 

 

 

Build and Evolve 

  • Own engineer self-service with an API-first design. The CLI, automation, and any developer portal all use the same platform API. Treat every ticket to the platform team as a gap in self-service and close the most common ones first. 
  • Keep a service catalogue in code, with an owner for every service and scorecards that show each team where its services stand against the golden path, production-readiness, and security standards. 
  • Provide multi-cluster deployment for internal teams and the customer product: one pipeline to every region and data centre, the customer product isolated from internal workloads, and sites that keep running when the orchestrator is unreachable. 
  • Let AI agents work on the delivery path under the same controls as engineers, with their own identity, least privilege, sandboxing, and a person approving every production change. 

 

 Reliability, security, and cost 

  • Set SLOs and error budgets for the platform and use the budget to decide when reliability work comes first. 
  • Lead the technical response to major incidents in the platform and make sure every post-mortem ends with a fix that stops it happening again. 
  • Set the standard every change meets before it goes live: code review, acceptance tests, builds traceable from source to deploy, and the application security team's controls in every pipeline by default. 
  • Provide secrets, certificates, and single sign-on as platform services, built to the security team's identity and secrets standard, with mutual TLS between services and credentials issued from code, short-lived, and rotated automatically. 
  • Build continuous compliance for SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the platform, with controls written as policy in code, evidence collected automatically, and drift detected and corrected. 
  • Automate patching without disruption and land urgent and embargoed security fixes within defined timelines. Nodes are replaced site by site from rebuilt images, within each service's disruption limits and with automatic rollback. 
  • Own cost at the design level, including cloud spend, with one shared path for every team and site. 

 

Technical leadership 

  • Grow engineers through mentorship, design review, and code review. Hiring and performance review sit with the Engineering Manager. 
  • Set how the team uses AI to build software effectively and securely, with review gates and automated architecture checks that keep AI-generated code within the agreed design. 
  • Own the technical interviews and assessments for platform engineers and hold every candidate to that bar. 

 

Partnership and communication 

  • Shape the platform roadmap with product, infrastructure, network, and site-delivery leaders, and have the platform ready before each new region or data centre goes live. 
  • Agree ownership in writing at each boundary with infrastructure, network, security, software, data and observability, and settle disagreements directly. 
  • Represent the platform team in customer and auditor reviews of security, reliability, and compliance. 

 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 10+ years in platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including at least 3 years at principal level or equivalent, setting the technical direction that multiple teams delivered against. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way. 
  • Has owned a golden path other engineers used to ship: infrastructure as code (such as Terraform or OpenTofu), CI/CD, and GitOps (such as Argo CD or Flux), with progressive rollout, rollback, artifact signing and provenance, and security gates in the pipeline. 
  • Has run a platform as a product, with self-service through templates and a platform API or CLI that teams adopted, measured by adoption and delivery performance rather than uptime alone. 
  • Has built, upgraded, and recovered Kubernetes on self-managed servers, including on virtualised infrastructure, as well as in a public cloud such as AWS, across more than one site. 
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Kubernetes internals: the API server and etcd, scheduling, networking (such as Cilium, with mutual TLS), storage, and admission control. 
  • Strong in Go or Python, with services, controllers, or tools other teams consume, not only infrastructure code. 
  • Has built security into a platform: secrets management (such as Vault or OpenBao), certificate automation, short-lived credentials, and fleet patching with no visible impact on services, under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent control set. 
  • Has run a reliability programme other engineers followed: SLOs and error budgets, change control, and incident reviews that changed the system. 
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, able to explain problems, decisions, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and customers. 
  • Willing to join the on-call rotation for the services you own and to travel overseas occasionally. 

 

Location & Reporting

  •  Location: we are open to offer capable candidates to be based in either Australia or Singapore
  • Report to: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering

 

Employment Basis

Full-time

 

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role: The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle. What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer: - Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria. Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases. Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests. Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage. Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time. Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline. Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation. Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis. Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases. Experience and skills required: - Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services. Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools. Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios. Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation. Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes. Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context. Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset. Advanced proficiency in the English language. Applicants must be based in South, North or Central America (applications from other locations will not be considered). This is a fully remote role , reporting to our Tech Lead. title: Senior Information Security Officer
description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

ACT is strengthening its data, technology and AI capabilities as we build a more integrated digital platform alongside our core environmental commodities trading and market-making business. This transformation is commercially driven, enabling us to scale, deepen client relationships and support increasingly complex and digital markets.

As Senior Information Security Officer, you will own ACT’s enterprise information security strategy and governance at Group level, spanning our core operations, emerging digital businesses and client-facing technology platforms. You will define the security risk appetite, lead our response to an evolving threat landscape, and ensure security and resilience are embedded by design as our technology landscape develops.

Working across business and technology leadership, you will translate commercial ambition into a pragmatic and scalable security posture that protects our systems and data while maintaining the trust of clients, counterparties and regulators. In essence, your role involves:

Strategy & Governance

  • Own the Group-wide information security strategy and roadmap across ACT’s core market-making business and digital and client-facing platforms, aligned with business goals and industry frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF. Define and maintain ACT’s cyber risk appetite.
  • Establish and lead security governance, including policies, standards and control frameworks, with clear accountability across the Group. Report on security posture and material incidents to executive leadership and, where relevant, the Board.

Client Platforms & Secure-by-Design

  • Embed security-by-design into new products and client platforms, partnering with Data, Architecture and Commercial teams to ensure emerging digital capabilities are secure from inception, while acting as a credible security voice to clients and counterparties.
  • Oversee application, product and SaaS security, embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle for internal and client-facing platforms, and assessing third-party services handling ACT and counterparty data.

Risk & Resilience

  • Lead enterprise security risk management, including risk assessments, vulnerability management and third-party/supply-chain risk, driving timely mitigation across core and digital environments.
  • Direct incident preparedness and response, coordinating detection, containment, eradication and recovery, while continuously strengthening incident and crisis-management plans.

Infrastructure & Emerging Technology

  • Secure ACT’s cloud and infrastructure through Zero-Trust-aligned controls, including identity and access management, segmentation and encryption, across a hybrid and multi-platform environment.
  • Govern emerging technology and AI security, extending security oversight to AI and data platforms, including model and data-exposure risks and AI-enabled threats, as ACT expands its use of AI.

Compliance & Leadership

  • Ensure regulatory and compliance alignment, including GDPR, DORA and relevant sector obligations, advising the business on required adaptations and coordinating audits and certifications.
  • Lead the security function and strengthen security culture across the Group, developing the team, raising security awareness, and acting as ACT’s primary authority and trusted advisor on cyber security to executives and business leaders, working alongside existing teams and capabilities.

 

 

 

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes: 

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field. A relevant Master’s degree is an advantage.
  • 10–15 years of progressive experience in information security and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior security role, with ownership of enterprise security strategy, governance and risk management.
  • Broad security leadership experience across incident response, cloud and infrastructure security, product/application security and regulatory compliance. Experience securing client-facing platforms or digital products is highly valuable.
  • Experience within trading, financial services, commodities or another data-intensive and regulated environment is highly advantageous.
  • Strong knowledge of security frameworks and standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls, with practical experience implementing them.
  • Good understanding of data protection, regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, DORA and standards such as SOC 2.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA, or equivalent, are highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex security risks into clear business implications and advise technical teams, executives, business stakeholders and clients.

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

description: Senior Integrity Engineer Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it. Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe. About Intero Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities. Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity . Your team You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department. Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients. Why this role matters An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on. raw.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
raw.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.
