raw.description:
Over GEODIS

GEODIS heeft zich ten doel gesteld Europees leider te worden in de logistieke dienstverlening. We streven naar Stakeholders Total Satisfaction (STS): totale tevredenheid van onze klanten, medewerkers, partners, maatschappij en aandeelhouders. Onze missie? Klanten succesvol maken door het optimaliseren van hun logistieke processen. Wij zijn experts in transport- en logistieke oplossingen, verenigd door passie, toewijding, innovatie en betrouwbaarheid.

Functieomschrijving

Wil jij bouwen aan een efficiënte, veilige en klantgerichte logistieke operatie voor een toonaangevende fashion-klant? GEODIS zoekt een Senior Operations Manager die dagelijks het verschil maakt in Almere. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de optimale afhandeling van de in- en uitgaande goederenstromen, opslag en Value Added Services, en draagt bij aan het waarborgen van kwaliteit, klant- én medewerkerstevredenheid. Bij afwezigheid van de Site Manager neem jij de eindverantwoordelijkheid op de site.

Jouw impact

Als Senior Operations Manager geef je direct leiding aan 2-5 Operations Managers/Supervisors en stuur je operationele teams aan. Je bewaakt het operationeel beleid, signaleert verbeterpunten, stuurt op KPI’s en SLA’s, en zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen kwaliteit, efficiency, kostenbeheersing en medewerkerstevredenheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Beleid

  • Uitdragen, monitoren en evalueren van het operationeel beleid zoals opgesteld door de Site Manager

  • Signaleren en formuleren van verbeterpunten voor nieuwe logistieke werkwijzen en methodes

Budget/Financieel

  • Weekly rapportage aan de Site Manager

  • Opstellen van prijsvoorstellen voor Value Added Services (VAS)

  • Mede opstellen/beoordelen van afdelingsbegrotingen

  • Mede verantwoordelijk voor kostenbeheersing, facturatie en urenregistratie

Relatiebeheer

Operatie

  • Diensten verlenen aan klanten conform contract/SLA

  • Vaststellen van operationele doelstellingen en normeringen

  • Efficiënte planning en administratie binnen het operationele proces, prioriteiten bepalen

  • Bewaken van processen, werkinstructies, kwaliteit, kwantiteit en continuïteit van dienstverlening

  • Bijdragen aan multidisciplinaire projecten als projectmanager

  • Monitoren van SLA’s, tijdig ingrijpen/escaleren indien nodig

Kwaliteit

  • Realiseren van kwantitatieve en meetbare kwaliteitsdoelstellingen (KPI’s)

  • Minimaliseren van schades

  • Verantwoordelijk voor 5S-methodiek binnen de afdeling

  • Orde en netheid van de werkplek bewaken

  • Rapporteren van KPI’s via Balanced Score Card/Management By Facts

Rapportage

  • Financiële en operationele prestaties rapporteren aan de Site Manager

  • Adequate administratieve afhandeling in het WMS verzorgen

  • Rapporteren over voorraadbeheer (accuracy en beheer fysieke/systematische voorraad)

Personeel en Organisatie

  • Aansturen, coachen, beoordelen en ontwikkelen van medewerkers

  • Optimale personeelsbezetting realiseren samen met de dedicated HR business partner

  • Begeleiden van werkoverleg, selectie, introductie, functionerings- en beoordelingsgesprekken

  • Rapporteren van afwijkingen (ongevallen, bijna-ongevallen)

  • Correcte urenregistratie en personeelsplanning

Veiligheid

  • Naleven van veiligheidsrichtlijnen en –regels

  • Bewaken van veiligheid van medewerkers en bezoekers

  • Signaleren van gevaarlijke situaties en voorstellen tot verbetering initiëren

Kwaliteit, Veiligheid en Milieu

  • Handelen conform het STS-QSE beleid (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 22000)

  • Procedures en richtlijnen naleven zoals vastgelegd in het QSE-managementsysteem

Wat bieden wij?

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer

  • 6.000 - 7.500 bruto per maand (fulltime, 40 uur)

  • (Elektrische) leaseauto

  • 24 vakantie- en 3,5 ATV dagen

  • Moderne, geautomatiseerde werkomgeving in Almere

Profiel & Vereisten

A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

Candidate Note: This position is 100% remote

EDB is building the next generation of AI agent infrastructure on top of Postgres including an Agent Hub, an Agent Memory layer, MCP, governance and trust controls, and enterprise-grade retrieval.

We're looking for an experienced Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to own the ML infrastructure spanning serving, evaluation, red-teaming, and continuous improvement for governance models. And turning Postgres into a first-class platform for AI agents.

What your impact will be:

  • Serving & evaluations: low-latency serving, eval pipelines, model registry.
  • Research-to-production: <50ms inference via quantization/distillation, drift monitoring, shadow deployment, telemetry-to-training pipelines.
  • Red-team harness: attack orchestration, scorecards, regression suites, CI gating.
  • Self-improvement loop: continuous retraining, dataset curation from the audit trail, gated auto-rollout.

What you will bring:

  • 4–7 years of professional machine learning software engineering experience, with hands-on work on LLM-based or agentic systems.
  • Deep production ML serving experience (low-latency inference, quantization/distillation).
  • Evaluation pipeline and model registry experience.
  • Red-team/adversarial testing harness experience (CI-gated regression suites).
  • Drift monitoring/shadow deployment experience.
  • Fluency with SQL and PostgreSQL.
  • Security first mindset and experience in audited environments.

What will give you an edge:

  • Experience building auto-retraining loops from production telemetry/audit data.
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool registries, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Postgres extension development in C or Rust, or contributions to the Postgres ecosystem.

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.

EDB does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. EDB and its affiliates are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other similar payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written signed agreement between EDB and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together. What are we looking for? We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates. You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision. What technologies will you work with? We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software. Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems. What will you do? You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement. You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners. You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs. You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems. You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas. You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms. You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code. You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments. You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience. You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment. You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks. You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision. What will you NOT do? You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health. You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business. You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success. You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working. You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it. Can I work remotely? Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel. Requirements Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles. Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features. At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database. Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish. Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently. A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful. Five or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch. Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries. Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices. Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes. Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment. Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality. Bonus (Helpful, but not required) Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem. Experience with React or Next.js. raw.jobDescription:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.

You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.

What technologies will you work with?

We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.

  • Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS
  • Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery

We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

What will you do?

  • You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.
  • You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.
  • You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.
  • You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.
  • You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas.
  • You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms.
  • You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code.
  • You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments.
  • You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience.
  • You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment.
  • You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks.
  • You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.
  • You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.
  • You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.
  • You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.
  • You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Requirements

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles.
  • Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features.
  • At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database.
  • Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish.
  • Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently.
  • A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful.
  • Five or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch.
  • Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries.
  • Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices.
  • Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes.
  • Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.
  • Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality.

Bonus (Helpful, but not required)

  • Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem.
  • Experience with React or Next.js.
  • Experience modernizing established applications or incrementally replacing legacy systems.
  • Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or other fast-moving environment.
  • Experience building products in health care, mental health, or another highly regulated or privacy-sensitive field.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the growth of other engineers.

raw.jobDescription:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

We want you to join us full-time as a Staff Backend Engineer. You will work remotely first (from Central & Eastern Europe), but we are more than happy to meet you in our nice offices in Bratislava, Brno or Prague.

The Pulsar team builds platform and admin services that all Bloomreach SaaS products rely on. In your first year, you’ll develop features used by thousands of customers and deliver fast, consistent, and high-energy (but low-drama) product releases. We all work remotely from the US, India, and Europe.

Examples of our services:

  • Central services to publish Model Context Protocol APIs for external AI agents
  • Multi-product customer provisioning and licensing orchestration
  • Integrated user management, authentication, and authorization
  • High-availability, centralized configuration management
  • Tools for new customer integration & product tuning

Why you’ll love your work

  • Technical Variety: Cloud-native services with diverse tech stacks offer learning and experimentation.
  • Impact: Our services are used by customers and teams across the company – engineers, product managers, services consultants, and even executives.
  • Autonomy: Senior engineers design, build, and deploy complete projects and are experts in our services.
  • Teamwork: Your teammates are also high performers and will support you with learning our systems, brainstorming & design review, and running high-reliability production deployments.

Your typical day

Your day begins with review of a teammate’s GitLab merge request. It has already been reviewed by Claude, but you’ll think deeply about the business problem, alternative solutions, and future needs.

Then you spend a few undisturbed hours “in the flow,” working on a technical design doc for a new project. Once you’ve completed a draft, you send it to another teammate for feedback, then decide to jump on a Zoom call to talk it over and refine it.

After lunch, you join the team for a quick standup via Zoom to discuss current work and the plan for the next few days. You mention that you’re finishing up a small improvement to improve the logging and alerting for one of our components that requires high uptime. A teammate offers to review your changes. It has some complex behavior, so you walk through it together and make a few improvements.

Soon, the new unit tests are green. With a few keystrokes, you create a merge request, spin up a dev instance, and deploy your change. After some quick smoke tests, you and your teammate decide to merge the change. Your improvement will be deployed in production with the release in a few days.

Next, you respond to a Slack request for advice on integrating with the authorization API. You draft a short tech design doc that links the API spec, code examples, and optimization tips. You discuss it on the team channel, and your manager forwards it to another team that’s also starting a new service.

Your day ends with a chat with a product manager about questions that came up while drafting the tech design. With their feedback, you refine the proposal to deliver the core feature more quickly, while the product manager will work with customers and decide how much more to invest. Tomorrow, you’ll break down the tasks in Jira and decide what you’ll complete yourself and what you’ll ask teammates to complete….

Our tech stack(s)

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java / Spring, Python, Go – occasionally TypeScript, Angular, React
  • Data: Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka
  • Cloud: AWS & GCP (RDS, Redshift, Pub/Sub, BigTable, DataFlow, etc), Docker & Kubernetes (via EKS & GKE)
  • Tools: Jira, Gitlab CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch

Our expectations

  • Flexible intelligence: Stretch your technical skills in a distributed cloud environment, making changes across systems built with various tech stacks to meet challenging requirements.
  • Drive: Rapidly ship product improvements that affect thousands of users in a low-drama and high-trust way.
  • Security & Reliability: Balance risks and benefits of change with discipline and agility.
  • Communication: Organize technical work and maintain trust/respect across multiple teams, geographic regions, and departments.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Proactively share expertise, guide less experienced team members, and document work for long-term sustainability.

The ideal candidate’s experience

  • Active user of AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude Code
  • Developed backend services with Python using a variety of data systems (5+ years)
  • Understands web security principles (OWASP), Authentication, and Authorization practices
  • Designed APIs for a SaaS product
  • Operated services in production on public cloud infrastructure
  • Some experience with Java / Spring or Go
  • Exposure to web frontend development (Angular / React)

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join the Financial Audit team at Fieldguide. Financial Audit is one of our most important strategic bets right now, and this is a high-impact role on a team that's building something new. You'll own major workstreams tied to our largest customer onboardings and most ambitious product bets, working alongside engineers, product managers, designers, and financial audit subject matter experts who are all deeply embedded in the problem.

  • Partner with product and design to shape what we build, not just how we build it, bringing technical perspective into roadmap and strategy conversations early

  • Mentor and grow the engineers around you through code review, pairing, and the way you approach and communicate hard problems

Who You Are

  • Experienced in setting technical direction at the team or org level, not just delivering within it

  • Comfortable operating where the requirements are unclear and the right answer isn't obvious

  • Already using AI coding tools as a core part of how you work, and thoughtful about where agentic approaches create real leverage

  • Able to build deep domain knowledge fast; you don't need to know financial auditing today, but you'll understand it well enough to make the right technical calls within months

Bonus Points

title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.
  • Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.
  • Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.
  • Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.
  • Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.
  • Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.
  • Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.
  • Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring

  • Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.
  • Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.
  • Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.
  • The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.
  • Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.
  • Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.
  • Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.

If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all-remote.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

description:
Wat ga je doen?


Wil je samen bouwen aan leuke projecten? 

Krijg je energie van het uitwerken van complexe vraagstukken en het adviseren van klanten in hun bedrijfsprocessen? Als senior Production consultant sleutel je in wisselende projectteams aan het ontwerp, de realisatie en implementatie van Microsoft Dynamics 365 voor klanten in de productie-industrie. Met jouw kennis zet je rock-solid oplossingen neer bij onze klanten, stuk voor stuk indrukwekkende spelers die jou een unieke inkijk geven in hun business (van shopfloor tot data analytics).

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent een ondernemende teamspeler en een pro actieve consultant op alle niveaus, van eindgebruiker tot management.
  • Denken in en vanuit processen, niet vanuit schermen/velden;
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en vraagt door, je wilt de vraag achter de vraag weten;
  • Je hebt een helicopterview;
  • Je wil het naadje van de kous weten (en kunnen uitleggen) als het gaat om bedrijfsapplicaties en hoe deze bedrijfsprocessen van de klant kunnen ondersteunen en verbeteren.
  • Je integreert soepel in een team en gaat voor een goede samenwerking met klanten en collega’s.
  • Je bent ambitieus en je wilt je graag verbinden aan een organisatie die gaat voor de lange termijn.
  • Oftewel: jij zoekt uitdaging om je te ontwikkelen en om je loopbaan verder vorm te geven.


Je beschikt over

  • Een afgeronde HBO- of WO opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van Engineering (Industrial of logistics), Supply Chain Management of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • Minimaal 5+ jaar ervaring als ERP-consultant of in een functie waarin je intensief hebt gewerkt met ERP binnen het productie domein;
  • Ervaring met diverse grondvormen (ETO, MTO, MTS, ATO, CTO);
  • Ervaring met zowel discrete- als procesindustrie
  • Deze kennis en ervaring heb je bij voorkeur aangevuld met ervaring in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management of een vergelijkbaar ERP systeem;
  • Goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

 

Wat bieden we jou?   

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties; 
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daarbovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO  

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

description:
About SiTime

SiTime Corporation is the precision timing company. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power and better reliability. With more than 3 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit www.sitime.com.

Job Summary 

Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best silicon Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. As a Principal MEMS Development Engineer, you will use your technical and creative problem-solving skills to push forward MEMS technology and engineer resonators for SiTime’s next-generation timing products. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead definition and execution of challenging technical projects. 
  • Advise management of challenges, impact, recommendations.
  • Develop new or improved resonators, MEMS technologies and/or products.
  • Design MEMS devices and characterize their electrical, mechanical, and thermal performance on wafer level and/or device level. 
  • Work with process team to drive continuous improvement in MEMS yields.
  • Extend and enhance automated infrastructure for MEMS design, measurements, and data analysis.
  • Design and analyze experiments to understand device physics, materials, and fabrication.
  • Interface with local and overseas vendors.
  • Work in cross-functional teams, including circuits, systems, and packaging.
  • Working/supporting other projects as needed.

 Qualifications & Requirements:  

  • Ph.D. in ME, EE, Physics, or equivalent
  • At least 3 years of industry experience.
  • Skilled scientist with ability to design, conduct, and analyze experiments.
  • Excellent problem identification and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent knowledge of mechanics, electrodynamics, thermodynamics.
  • Knowledge in fundamentals of MEMS devices physics and fabrication.
  • Experience with finite element simulation tools (COMSOL, ANSYS) and data processing tools (Matlab, Python).
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Passion for delivering exceptional results.

 Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • 3 -10 years of industry experience.
  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge of programing languages, circuits, metrology equipment and methods.
  • Experience with Statistical analysis and tools such as R or JMP.
  • Knowledge in MEMS microfabrication.

 Compensation Range:  

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent. 


 In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity

Born from deep-tech innovation at TU Delft, our team of visionary engineers and bold thinkers is tackling the toughest challenges in GNSS and IoT, starting with power consumption and expanding into dynamic, context-aware solutions that adapt to any environment or use case. At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

What Sets Us Apart

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology, you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

Job Description 

As a Test Engineer, you will support the development and production release of test solutions for Qualinx products. Working closely with Design, Product Engineering, Reliability, and external manufacturing partners, you will contribute to digital and memory test development activities, product characterization, yield improvement, and production support.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development, validation, and release of production test solutions for Qualinx products.

  • Support in developing and debugging ATE test programs for wafer sort and final test.

  • Support silicon characterization, correlation, and production qualification activities.

  • Analyze test results and production data to identify issues and opportunities for yield improvement.

  • Work with Design and Product Engineering teams to investigate test failures and support root cause analysis.

  • Contribute to test time optimization and test coverage improvements.

  • Support OSAT and manufacturing partners during product bring-up and production ramp.

  • Assist in implementing and validating digital test methodologies, including SCAN, MBIST, JTAG, and Flash testing.

  • Develop automation scripts and tools to improve test efficiency and data analysis.

  • Maintain test documentation and support continuous improvement of test processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum five years of experience in semiconductor test engineering, product engineering, or a related role.

  • Semiconductor test development and production test flow experience.

  • Experience with semiconductor testing at wafer sort and/or package level.

  • Experience with embedded digital interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, SWD, and JTAG.

  • Understanding of digital test methodologies, including SCAN, MBIST, JTAG/Boundary Scan, IDDQ and Flash Memory Testing

  • Experience with ATE platforms or test development environments such as NI and Teradyne IG-XL.

  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, C/C++, MATLAB, or similar languages.

  • Understanding of electronics fundamentals and digital circuit operation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a diverse cross-functional team.

  • Experience with NI PXIe, Teradyne J750HD, or UltraFLEX platforms.

 

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g MATLAB, JMP, or equivalent).

  • Experience with ATPG and vector conversion flows using tools for production ATE implementation.

  • Knowledge of Design-for-Test (DFT) concepts, including Scan, MBIST, JTAG, Boundary Scan, and ATPG.

  • Experience working with OSATs in NPI and high-volume manufacturing environments.

  • Exposure to WLCSP products, wafer sort, and wafer-level development and testing methodologies.

  • Experience with test data analysis and yield monitoring tools is preferred.

title: Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek
description: Ben jij een ervaren Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek die impact wil maken in uitdagende Life Sciences-projecten? Ontwerp geavanceerde, duurzame installaties voor high-tech laboratoria, waar jouw expertise écht het verschil maakt. Bij Deerns krijg je de ruimte om complexe projecten te leiden en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van wetenschap en gezondheidszorg. De uitdaging Als Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek binnen de Life Sciences speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerp van complexe en technisch productiefaciliteiten, zoals laboratoria. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige elektrotechnische installaties, van energievoorziening tot communicatie- en beveiligingssystemen. Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang binnen het ontwerp. Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp- en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria of productiefaciliteiten. Uitwerken van elektrotechnische installaties op het gebied van o.a. energievoorziening, verlichting, brandveiligheid, zwakstroom-, beveiligings- en communicatievoorzieningen. Opstellen van kabel- en lichtberekeningen met behulp van gespecialiseerde software. Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines. Ondersteunen van de ontwerpleider en projectmanager in de communicatie met klanten en partners. Hier is waar We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. SRON verhuisde naar het Leiden BioScience Park en stelde hoge eisen aan het nieuwe gebouw op het gebied van duurzaamheid, cleanrooms en installatietechniek. Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Daarom koos Deerns in het ontwerp voor warmtepompen voor verwarming en koeling van het gebouw en werden er zonnepanelen op het dak geïnstalleerd. Bovendien kreeg het gebouw het BREEAM-NL certificaat Excellent. We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe, duurzame DSM Lab 6 in Delft, waar Deerns alle technische installaties, elektrische systemen, IT-infrastructuur, beveiliging, mechanische systemen, HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), transport- en utiliteitssystemen verzorgde. Tijdens de ontwerpfase werden ook de technische en financiële haalbaarheid grondig gecontroleerd. Op basis van de inval van zonlicht in het gebouw, de energieprestatie-eisen en de strenge eisen voor de binnentemperatuur ontwierp Deerns een gevel die voor 25% gesloten is. Dit zorgt voor een natuurlijk koel binnenklimaat, waardoor energie wordt bespaard op verwarmings-, ventilatie- en airconditioningsystemen. Dit ben jij Jij hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor (Hbo/ Wo) in Electrical engineering of een andere technische opleiding. Jij hebt al enige ervaring opgedaan als Engineer Elektrotechniek en bent klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière. Jij hebt ervaring met werken in projecten en bent een uitstekende teamspeler. Je hebt uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel geschreven als gesproken). MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en andere berekeningsprogramma’s hebben geen geheimen voor jou. Dit bieden wij Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. Over Deerns Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work! Kennis maken? Wil je meer weten over werken bij Deerns? Neem dan contact op met Maarten Borgmeijer (Corporate Recruiter) via +31 6 11 66 75 44. Wil je meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Neem dan contact op met Ester Vlielander (Unit Director Data Center en Life Sciences) via +31 6 50 73 68 41 Ben je enthousiast geworden? Reageer met jouw cv via de sollicitatie button. Je ontvangt binnen drie werkdagen een reactie. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van de vacatures op onze website wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Cv's en/of voorstellen die ongevraagd aan ons worden gemaild worden niet in behandeling genomen! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Teamleider en Senior Adviseur Brandveiligheid
raw.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Adviseur Brandveiligheid die niet alleen excelleert in complexe, grootschalige projecten, maar ook graag het voortouw neemt in het aansturen, coachen en laten groeien van een team? In deze rol combineer je inhoudelijke expertise met leiderschap en speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons team Brandveiligheid.

 

De uitdaging 
Als Teamleider Brandveiligheid bij Deerns sta jij aan het roer van een groeiend team van specialisten en geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. Het team bestaat momenteel uit een mix van ervaren experts en talentvolle adviseurs en bevindt zich in een fase van sterke groei. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei in goede banen te leiden, het team verder uit te bouwen en te versterken zowel in omvang als in kwaliteit en positionering.

Je combineert strategisch leiderschap met inhoudelijke diepgang en bent bepalend voor de kwaliteit, koers en groei van het team. Je creëert een omgeving waarin professionals excelleren, kennis wordt gedeeld en innovatie wordt gestimuleerd.

Brandveiligheid zit in ieder project. Of het nu gaat om de nieuwbouw van een ziekenhuis, een ‘state of the art’ cleanroom, de bouw van een (houten) woontoren, of de nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatie van een (multi-tenant) kantoorcomplex. In al deze ontwerpen speelt brandveiligheid een cruciale rol.

In de rol van adviseur opereer je op senior niveau en werk je aan complexe brandveiligheidsvraagstukken binnen al onze adviesgroepen: Gezondheidszorg, Clean Technology, Vastgoed en Luchthavens. Dit zorgt voor een grote variatie aan aansprekende projecten, nationaal en internationaal.

Samen met een team van adviseurs en ervaren experts zorg je voor slimme, effectieve en toekomstbestendige brandveiligheidsconcepten. Je helpt opdrachtgevers brandrisico’s te herkennen en te beheersen, zorgt dat ontwerpen voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving én aansluiten bij de ambities van de opdrachtgever. Tegelijkertijd fungeer je als inhoudelijk sparringpartner en mentor voor collega’s binnen het team.


Als Teamleider en Senior Adviseur Brandveiligheid ben jij verantwoordelijk voor:

Teamleider:

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het team Brandveiligheid, inclusief werkvoorraad, resultaten, kwaliteit, capaciteit en voortgang van het werk.

  • Je stuurt actief op performance en ontwikkeling van je teamleden, voert beoordelings- en ontwikkelgesprekken en grijpt in waar nodig.

  • Je bewaakt en optimaliseert planning, productiviteit en werkverdeling en zorgt dat projecten efficiënt en op niveau worden uitgevoerd.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke koers en verdere professionalisering van brandveiligheid binnen Deerns.

  • Je vertegenwoordigt het team richting management en opdrachtgevers en adviseert over strategie, capaciteit en teamontwikkeling.

  • Je bent samen met de 5 andere teamleiders onderdeel van het MT van de Unit Building Performance NL, dat onder leiding van de Unit Director (Pieter Schepman) vorm geeft aan de strategie en ontwikkeling van de Unit.


Adviseur Brandveiligheid:

  • Je hebt veel contact met opdrachtgevers en potentiele opdrachtgevers over onderwerpen gerelateerd aan brandveiligheid.

  • Je adviseert onze opdrachtgevers integraal en conceptueel in de vroege ontwerpfasen van projecten.

  • Je stuurt de collega’s waarmee je aan de projecten werkt inhoudelijk en procesmatig aan.

  • Je maakt samen met de andere teamleden (complexe) brandveiligheidsberekeningen en denkt mee in ontwerpen.

  • Je stemt brandveiligheidsaspecten af met interne collega’s en externe ontwerppartijen in alle ontwerpfases.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten, communiceert hierover en draagt zorg voor passende oplossingen.

  • Je vertaalt brandveiligheidsaspecten naar rapportages, plattegronden en 3D-ontwerpen (Revit/BIM).

Het team en de projecten
Je komt te werken in een hecht team van junioren, mediors en ervaren experts. Het kernteam bestaat uit 13 collega’s die goed op elkaar ingespeeld zijn met elk hun eigen achtergrond en expertise. Ons team levert de best passende oplossing voor nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatievraagstukken, voor overheden, bedrijven en instellingen van nagenoeg iedere schaalgrootte. Geen project is hetzelfde! Ben je benieuwd naar onze projecten, klik dan hier.

 

Dit bieden wij 

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. 

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor te werken. 

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. 

 

Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work!

raw.title: PlanetScale: Enterprise Support Engineer
raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote - NA, APAC, EMEA

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Vitess, an open-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL, enables businesses to efficiently handle large-scale data workloads — without sacrificing developer experience.

Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our core engineering team and help us build the next generation of database infrastructure.

What's the job to be done?

  • You will advise and handle support requests from enterprise customers on the PlanetScale platform.
  • You will become a customer-facing subject-matter expert for enterprise customers on the PlanetScale platform.
  • You will identify product gaps in a customer-specific context and work with Technical Account Management, Engineering and Sales Engineering teams to prioritize and escalate them.
  • You will be part of an on call rotation for high priority issues.

These attributes best describe you…

  • You are comfortable in front of customers, empathetic but understanding when to push back to help customers become successful on their own.
  • You have excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills; with a mix of enough experience and intuition to zero in on root-causes for bugs that can leave others stumped.
  • You are comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone. Be it delving into unfamiliar code in Vitess, one of its dependencies, or a random MySQL connector, written in a language you may not know (yet!). Working with code as your main source of documentation doesn't fluster you, and you are happy to help add/correct it as necessary where it may be inaccurate.
  • You can operate independently, but you know when you are in too deep and need to ask for help.
  • You know how to work under pressure in times of urgency. We and our customers both take issues with their data platform seriously.

What you will need

  • Experience supporting production databases and applications, preferably at scale.
  • Experience with database internals and peformance tuning, specifically for PostgreSQL and MySQL databases
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes.
  • Strong ability to communicate and deal directly with customers, whether in email, Slack, video conference, or in person.

What else will help you be successful

  • Knowledge of common application deployment platforms and frameworks. Eg Python, Go, Node, PHP
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Knowledge of monitoring, observability, and debugging tools
  • Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the database or infrastructure space

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Salary range: US $120,000 - $200,000

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-enterprise-support-engineer

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

  • 100% remote work
  • Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
  • A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from
  • A MacBook set up and ready from day one, plus a $500 stipend to design your ideal workspace
  • Central European Time (CET) hours to support a balanced schedule for our Poland-based team
  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs

About the role

As a Software Engineer II, you bring growing technical depth, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of features and components across the product. You focus on building scalable, reliable systems, writing well-structured code, and contributing to solutions that deliver real customer value.

We are currently hiring Software Engineers II to join one of two teams within our Platform organization: Identity & Access Management (IAM) or API. The IAM team focuses on authentication, authorization, and access management, ensuring users can access only the resources and functionality they are permitted to use. One of the team’s key projects involves Keycloak, an open-source Identity and Access Management solution. The API team owns and improves the backend API layer that powers the Housecall Pro application, with a strong current focus on application performance and creating a fast, reliable user experience.

In this role, you will elevate team effectiveness by sharing knowledge, contributing to design and code reviews. Our team is passionate, empathetic, and committed to improving the lives of our service professionals, our Pros. Your impact will help strengthen our product, enhance user experiences, and support the long-term success of the people we serve.

Compensation: 5,300 - 6,600 USD per month

What you’ll do

  • Build a product that improves users’ lives (75k unique daily users, 4.6 ⭐at App Store) Learn more about the HCP product
  • Design, build, and maintain reliable, performant, and maintainable software systems that deliver real value to users
  • Take ownership of features or components from design through deployment, ensuring quality, scalability, and resilience
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate product goals into technical solutions
  • Participate actively in architectural discussions, code reviews, and design sessions, contributing constructive feedback and new ideas
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across the stack, identifying root causes and implementing robust fixes
  • Help shape technical standards and best practices that promote consistency, maintainability, and performance
  • Continuously grow your technical expertise and mentor more junior engineers through collaboration and example
  • Explore and apply emerging technologies, including AI, to improve developer productivity, system quality, and product innovation

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Solid understanding of software design principles, system architecture, and modern development practices
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages, with a willingness to learn new ones as needed
  • Experience building and maintaining production systems or applications, including debugging and performance optimization
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, able to work effectively across disciplines and teams
  • A problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Product-oriented thinking, motivated by building solutions that serve real customer needs
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and enthusiasm for learning and applying them
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, streamline execution, or enhance outputs
  • Nice to have: experience with Ruby / Rails, event-driven architectures, MySQL at scale, or previous work on an internal platform or infrastructure team
  • This position requires fluency in both Polish and English

What will help you succeed

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, streamline execution, or enhance outputs
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Product-oriented thinking, motivated by building solutions that serve real customer needs
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and enthusiasm for learning (including a willingness to master Ruby)
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and teams

How we work

You’ll join a small and senior squad focused on cross-cutting search concerns, working closely with Product Platform teams, IAM, DevOps, and SRE. We value clear ownership, pragmatic engineering, and iterating in small, safe steps. You’ll have room to shape our long-term search strategy while shipping meaningful improvements.

Our primary technology stack at HCP is Ruby. To be effective in this role, you’ll need to learn it. We offer support in the learning process, tailored to your needs and any prior experience with Ruby. This may include mentoring from our experienced engineering team or access to a paid online course that you can complete during working hours as part of your onboarding. The exact form of support will be agreed upon based on insights from your selection process.

Sounds interesting?

We're waiting for your resume!

This role is open to candidates in Poland. The specific salary for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About the Role:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.

What You'll Do:

  • Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
  • Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
  • Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
  • Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
  • Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
  • Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
  • Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
  • Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
  • Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
  • Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

What You Bring:

  • Experience: 3+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
  • Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
  • Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
  • Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
  • Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
  • Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
  • Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
  • Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
  • Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

    As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!
